name: Fresco Shift
summary: A sliding picture puzzle in a gallery: restore six hand-painted canvases tile by tile under a spotlight
about: A quiet gallery page with a spotlight, a gilded frame and a museum label that keeps your moves, time and par. Six original paintings drawn in code, from a river at dawn to a lotus pond, are cut into 3 × 3 up to 5 × 5 tiles; you slide them back until the seams vanish, the varnish shines and a gold restored seal stamps the frame. Restored paintings earn stars and unlock the next canvas in the catalogue strip.
how: A restorer solves a painting on load; press Start restoring, Let me try or an arrow key to play.
Click a tile in the gap's row or column to slide it (or the whole line), swipe on the board, or use the arrow keys or WASD.
Hold Peek or H to see the finished painting, and turn on 1 2 3 or press N to number the tiles.
Finish near the par move count for three stars; each restored painting unlocks the next in the strip below.
P or Escape covers the painting and stops the clock, and Shuffle or R starts the painting again.
Stars, unlocked paintings and your best total are kept on this device; reduced motion skips the fly-in and sweep.
